_meta.statsforecast_install: pip install --no-deps statsforecast==2.1.1 (plus its import-time deps coreforecast 0.0.18, fugue 0.9.7, triad 1.0.2, adagio 0.2.6, utilsforecast 0.2.17, fsspec, pyarrow, tqdm); pandas kept at the reference venv's version
_meta.note: CSS ARIMA, tsecon intercept convention. Leg A: statsforecast arima_css (C++ port of R's ARIMA_CSS) at fixed parameters, mean form mu = c/(1 - sum phi*), residuals after R's ncond = d + D s + p + s P. Leg B: AutoReg OLS = CSS optimum. Leg C: optimizer-defined optimum (scipy LM, BFGS spread recorded), bse from approx_hess3 of the conditional loglik with sigma2 free.

ar_autoreg.source: statsmodels AutoReg(lags=2, trend='c').fit(): OLS = the CSS optimum
